Programming Language Reference: Bash (Bourne Again SHell)
Version: GNU Bash 5.2 / IEEE Std 1003.1 (POSIX sh)
Syntax: Command language interpreter for Unix-like systems combining interactive command line with shell scripting.
Semantics: Text stream processing via standard streams (stdin, stdout, stderr), process pipelines, environment variables.
Type System: Untyped string-oriented; variables hold strings or arrays, arithmetic evaluated via $(( expression )).
Memory Model: Process virtual address space per subshell fork, environment variable inheritance via export.
Concurrency: Background jobs (&), wait command, named pipes (FIFOs), coprocs, signals (trap).
Error Handling: Exit status $? (0 = success, non-zero = error), set -e (errexit), set -u (nounset), set -o pipefail.
Standard APIs: echo, cd, read, test / [ ], export, trap, kill
Specification: Bash Reference Manual (Free Software Foundation)
Official Docs: https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/
